title: docs(releases): the 18.1.0 notes, and the 18.x level rule on every page that still promised strict SemVer after GA
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiRwWtsarkLPmw9fMYiFZ3LY)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

A docs-only PR (`content/docs/**` plus the docs-audit list). It publishes nothing from any released package, so it carries no changeset. It does not touch the Version Packages PR #24876, and it performs no release act.

## Why

I audited the 18.0 and 18.1 release docs against what shipped and what is pending:

- **18.0.0.** `releases/v18/18-0.mdx` is still accurate. `npm view` on 2026-10-23 reads `latest` = 18.0.0 and `next` = 18.0.0-next.5. Two pages around it had drifted:
  - **Upgrading → "Upgrading to 18.0"** describes three behaviours that only exist on `main` and gives them no version: #25155 (`--no-server` is no longer a way round the auth refusal), #25231 (a plugin-auth load failure is refused) and #25179 (`os migrate plan` lists nullable tenant columns). A reader on 18.0.0 is told about refusals that 18.0.0 does not make.
  - **Versioning policy.** Backward Compatibility says "the window closes at GA, and strict SemVer resumes from that point", and that a PATCH has "no behavior changes". The releases index says "A patch release fixes bugs." Ruling A (#25105, 2026-10-21) keeps the no-major guard and grades by the metadata protocol, so after 18.0.0 a non-protocol breaking change ships as `patch`. 18.1.0 is a minor that carries 82 changesets declared breaking, 37 of them graded `patch`, #25399 among them. A `^18.0.0` range takes it unattended.
- **18.1.0.** No page existed. I rehearsed `pnpm run version` in a throwaway clone of `main` (`2581efb`). It produces 18.1.0 across 73 packages with 227 distinct CHANGELOG entries. Every content gate the publish lane runs is green on that tree. The one exception is `check-release-section-coverage`, which is advisory: "NO heading on this page names the 18.1 series".
- **ADR-0087.** The registry is complete. `check-adr-0087-registration --list` shows 82 declared-breaking changesets, all 82 with a disposition and 0 residue: 9 `registered`, 7 `already-registered`, 61 `no-migration-prescription`, 4 `runtime-export-retired` and 1 `runtime-interface-only`. `check:upgrade-guide` and `check:spec-changes` both generate cleanly.

## What changes

- **`releases/v18/18-1.mdx` (new).** The 18.1.0 notes, compiled from the changesets, with the entries grouped by `classifyReleaseBullet` as the GitHub Release body groups them:
  - 73 entries need action from the reader, 9 are converted, 41 are new capabilities, 0 are semantic and 104 are fixes.
  - The page adds a Console section (pin `616df6598b42` → `1d178e06ac5e`, six refreshes, 91 objectui entries) and an upgrade checklist from 18.0.0.
  - Two callouts say the page was compiled before the cut and has not been walked.
  - The cloud-managed break (#25399) gets its own section, which says self-hosted deployments are unchanged.
- **`upgrading.mdx`.**
  - The three post-18.0.0 behaviours now say "from 18.1.0".
  - The per-release table gains a 18.1.0 row.
  - The sentence "a minor has nothing for `os migrate meta` to replay" now notes the nine step-18 conversions that 18.1.0 adds.
- **`protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`, `releases/index.mdx`, `releases/v18/index.mdx`.** These now state the post-GA level rule. The v18 index also links 18.1.0 and notes the 18.1.0 tightening of the auth-secret refusal.
- **`releases/v18/18-0.mdx`.** It now says that a caret range takes later 18.x releases, which can break, and section 4 points at the 18.1.0 notes.
- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`.** This regenerates with `--write` for the new page.

The "current series" field on the releases index is left to `sync-release-index-currency.mjs`. On the rehearsed post-version tree it stamps `18.1.0`, and `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:doc-anchors` and the section-coverage check are all green.

## Follow-up after the publish

These are not in this PR:

- A "Release facts, as measured" section, filled in with `npm view` after the publish.
- A walked 18.0.0 → 18.1.0 checklist, which replaces the "not walked" callouts.

## Verified locally

- `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:docs-redirects`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:release-index-currency-sync`, `check:published-readme-links` and `check:nul-bytes` are all green.
- An MDX 3 + GFM compile of the six edited pages passes.
